Proof in the paper: The peak located at a 2θ value of about 54° in the XRD pattern is referred to the carbon support. The other four peaks are characteristic of face-centred cubic (fcc) crystalline Pt, corresponding to the planes (1 1 1), (2 0 0), (2 2 0) and (3 1 1), respectively, indicating that the alloy catalyst has single-phase-disordered structures.
